g.text: Dynamic View: Android MCP bridge - Android bridge APK
Job discovery and atomic interest activation
1: Discover groups for a job and context budget
[MCP 2025-11-25 Streamable HTTP over authenticated loopback TCP/owner adb forward]
4: Read full searchable index and dependency closure
5: Query per-client permission status; discovery grants nothing
6: Return bounded ranked summaries with pinned cursor
7: Return ranked bounded summaries and discovery cursor
8: Request activation with selected IDs, pins and current group-view ETag
[MCP 2025-11-25 Streamable HTTP over authenticated loopback TCP/owner adb forward]
9: Begin requested atomic activation with expected pins
10: Validate availability and required type/dependency closure
11: CAS commit coherent activation or return stale/conflict
12: Return committed group view or explicit conflict
13: Return committed group epoch/hash; portable generic-invoke fallback remains
14: For opted-in dynamic aliases, best-effort tools/list_changed; host context eviction not guaranteed
